info.title: Markets API
info.description: The investing API behind Markets by MP. Public market-data endpoints are keyless within the documented limits (120 requests a minute per IP, 600 when signed in). Private endpoints need a signed-in session and only ever return your own data. **Stock, ETF, fund and index prices are generated demo data** until a licensed feed is connected. FX rates are real European Central Bank reference rates. Real crypto prices (CoinGecko) appear in the Markets app only; their terms do not allow redistribution here. Every response says where its data came from and when.

session.name: better-auth.session_token
session.description: Session cookie set by signing in on markets.marcantoniopovolo.com. Private endpoints are same-origin only; third-party access to private data will use explicit, scoped consent (not yet available).

tradable.description: False for indexes and FX pairs, which are not directly purchasable here.

change.description: Signed change from the previous close. Decimal string.

dayHigh.description: Session high so far. Decimal string.

dayLow.description: Session low so far. Decimal string.

observedAt.description: When the market value was observed (ISO 8601).

adjClose.description: Close adjusted for splits and distributions. Decimal string.

status.description: "projected" amounts and dates are estimates, not declarations.

dropPct.description: Signed percent from the reference high. Decimal string.

reference.description: Reference high on today's price basis. Decimal string.
